code_change_check.detail: The compiled symbol body and relocation list are byte-identical to the pre-review object, so this function's own code did not change; the file digest moved because other natives and globals were added to the same translation unit.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and radare2 both recover one function at 0x004C6670 with 3 blocks and 3 edges (0x004C6670 entry, loop head 0x004C66AA, exit 0x004C671E); angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry with no unresolved jumps. The candidate Terrain_CreateMaterial is at 0x00458600 in igi1.exe 35d92a3a, and its compiled body is byte-identical to the pre-review object.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja's prototype is int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc); arg2 is the script-argument pointer (it is passed to Script_EvalArgInt), so the 'float' word type is a typing artifact. The candidate declares void*(void* context, const float* args), preserving the two 32-bit argument words and order; the record's signature comparison is abi-adapted.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail computes Script_EvalArgInt(args,0)*5 then *0xB4, i.e. a 900-byte record stride from g_c28fe0 (0x00C28FE0); the loop starts at argument index 3 and steps 7 while i < 0xE3 (32 entries of 0x1C bytes). The two 0.5f factors load the constant at 0x00533504 (0x3F000000). The candidate uses the same stride, loop bounds and 0.5f.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail stores the int at record+0 and seven fields at record+4..record+0x1C, then copies a 0x18-byte context block whose dword at +0x10 is 0x00567C74. The candidate writes the same offsets and descriptor. Two declared deviations: the port clamps out-of-range indices into its 32-entry table (retail has no bounds check) and zeroes the context dwords retail leaves uninitialized; both are recorded and the fixtures use in-range indices.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail calls Script_EvalArgInt (0x004B8A20) and its float counterpart once per stored field; the candidate replaces that VM boundary with inline Script_GetArg/Script_GetArgFloat reads of the argument array. The differential harness hooks the retail accessors and supplies equivalent values, so the compared writes are the same global and context locations apart from the adapted accessor boundary.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail's EAX survives the rep-movsd context copy and is arg1; the candidate returns context on that path and adds a host-only null-args guard returning the same pointer. No retail error branch exists.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Each entry performs two fmul operations against the 0.5f constant at 0x00533504 and stores single-precision results. The candidate multiplies by 0.5f in the same positions; the differential report compares the resulting dwords with a 1e-6 float tolerance and passed 8/8.

limitations: Bounded differential evidence only: scripts/native_unicorn_runner.py executes the retail bytes for 8 fixtures under unicorn 2.1.4 x86-32 and a host-compiled build of the current source; it is not a live game process and not execution of the x86 candidate binary.
Retail does not bounds-check the material index; the port clamps into its 32-entry g_c28fe0 table, and the fixtures use only in-range groups.
Retail context dwords +0x04 and +0x14 come from uninitialized stack in the rep-movsd source; the port writes zero.
The retail script accessors 0x004B8A20/0x004B8A50 are replaced by inline host helpers; the harness hooks the retail accessors and feeds equivalent values.
